commands.command: set -euo pipefail; B='/tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-pre-update-data.tar'; test -f "$B"; H=$(shasum -a 256 "$B" | awk '{print $1}'); echo backup_sha256=$H; test "$H" = '2dadcc5a56f23adaa99e23655bc101f9261a5f0fa659f01d04c1aa4f05b42582'; echo TAR_LIST; tar tf "$B" | head -n 80; D=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; tar xf "$B" -C "$D"; DB=$(find "$D" -name tracker_database -type f | head -n1); test -n "$DB"; echo DB=$DB; sqlite3 "$DB" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) as devices from devices; select count(*) as signal_samples from signal_samples; select count(*) as follow_me_observations from follow_me_observations;'; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; echo RUN_AS_PWD; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye pwd; echo CURRENT_DATA; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -o -type d | head -n 100
